title.narrative: EU Support to Equal Opportunities and social development (EOSD)

description.narrative: Contract related to: EU Support to Equal Opportunities and social development (EOSD) - The action will contribute to the implementation of the Multi-Annual Indicative Programme 2021-2027 addressing the specific objective to strengthen socio-economic resilience, for inclusive growth and decent job creation and to promote and protect the values of democracy, human rights, and fundamental freedoms. The action addresses the achievement of sustainable development commitments in Egypt primarily with regard to SDG 16 ¿Peace, justice and strong institutions¿ and to SDG 10 ¿Reduce inequalities¿ The overall objective of the action is to contribute to Egypt's efforts towards strengthening and supporting human rights, youth and civil society. Equal opportunities and human development are core aspects to support growth and respect of human rights. Cross cutting issues such as gender, civil society participation, digitalisation and environment shall be also addressed. The action is divided in two main priority areas. The first one aims at supporting and enhancing a culture of human rights. The second one will work on youth empowerment acting a different layers namely: reinforcing the role of state actors; involving more actively non-state actors and addressing directly the youth population.  Through addressing the above-mentioned priority areas, the action will support achieving the objectives of the National Strategy for the Empowerment of Egyptian Women (2030) [1] and Egypt¿s Sustainable Development Strategy (SDS 2030) [2]; the Egyptian Strategy on Human Rights[3]; the EU Action Plan on Human Rights and Democracy 2020-2024[4]; the strategy for the Rights of Persons with Disabilities 2021[5]-2030; the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027[6]; the EU Gender Action Plan III (2021-25) and the Civil Society Roadmap for Egypt 2021 ¿ 2027.
